defect_description: Porosity found on MIG weld seam during visual and dye-penetrant inspection
containment_action: Quarantined WIP, 100% inspection of last 2 shifts
root_cause: Shielding gas flow low due to clogged nozzle and draft from open bay door
corrective_action: Replaced nozzles, set gas flow to spec, added draft screen
preventive_action: Added nozzle cleaning to shift start checklist and weekly flow-meter verification

defect_description: Journal diameter out of tolerance, 0.03 mm oversize on 40 mm bearing seat
root_cause: Tool wear on finishing insert, tool life counter not reset after insert change
preventive_action: Auto tool-life limit in CNC program and SPC chart on bearing seat diameter

defect_description: Paint peeling at edges after curing, failed cross-hatch adhesion test
containment_action: Stopped paint line, held painted fenders
root_cause: Pretreatment bath concentration below limit, leading to poor phosphate coating
corrective_action: Dosed bath to spec, re-tested adhesion on 10 parts
preventive_action: Automatic bath concentration monitoring and twice-per-shift titration log

defect_description: Oil leak at hose crimp fitting during end-of-line pressure test
containment_action: Re-tested all assemblies from same crimp batch
root_cause: Crimp die wear causing under-crimp, outside diameter below spec
corrective_action: Replaced crimp die, re-crimped suspect assemblies
preventive_action: Crimp diameter check every 50 pieces with go/no-go gauge

defect_description: Wheel hub bolts found below specified torque during audit
root_cause: Torque tool setting changed after battery swap, no verification step
corrective_action: Reset tool to spec and locked settings
preventive_action: Daily torque tool verification with calibrated transducer and error-proof lock-out

defect_description: Gear teeth hardness below drawing requirement, 52 HRC against 58 HRC minimum
containment_action: Rejected incoming lot, sorted stock at supplier and plant
root_cause: Supplier heat-treatment furnace temperature drift, no recent calibration
corrective_action: Supplier recalibrated furnace and re-treated lot
preventive_action: Supplier added hardness check per batch, plant added incoming hardness audit and supplier audit

defect_description: Incomplete weld penetration found in ultrasonic test
containment_action: 100% UT on all housings from the week
root_cause: Welding robot program offset after fixture repair, torch angle off by 5 degrees
corrective_action: Re-taught robot path and verified with macro-etch sample
preventive_action: Weld first-piece approval after any fixture or program change

defect_description: Burrs remaining on cross-drilled oil passages causing contamination in flushing test
root_cause: Deburring step skipped after process change, work instruction not updated
corrective_action: Reinstated deburring operation and updated work instruction
preventive_action: Added cleanliness check with particle count at final inspection

defect_description: Orange peel and dirt inclusions on top coat
containment_action: Held painted parts for rework and polish
root_cause: Booth filters overdue for replacement, airflow below limit
preventive_action: Differential pressure alarm on filters and preventive maintenance schedule

defect_description: Connector not fully seated causing intermittent dashboard fault
containment_action: Re-checked all connectors on tractors in yard
root_cause: Missing click-confirmation step in assembly, no pull test
corrective_action: Added audible click check and tug test to work instruction
preventive_action: Poka-yoke connector with locking indicator and operator training

defect_description: Weld leak detected in leak test at incoming inspection
containment_action: Returned lot, 100% leak test on stock
root_cause: Supplier weld parameters changed without notifying plant, no change approval
corrective_action: Supplier restored approved parameters and re-tested lot
preventive_action: Supplier change-notification requirement in quality agreement and PPAP revalidation

defect_description: Spool sticking in functional test, high pressure drop
root_cause: Contamination from cutting fluid residue after machining, washer nozzle blocked
corrective_action: Cleaned washer nozzles and revalidated cleanliness
preventive_action: Washer pressure monitoring and cleanliness audit per shift

defect_description: Incomplete weld penetration observed on fillet weld joining support bracket to mounting plate. Visual inspection and macro-etch testing revealed lack of fusion along approximately 30% of weld length.
containment_action: Conducted 100% visual and dye penetrant inspection of remaining brackets produced during same shift.
root_cause: Worn welding fixture locator pin caused 2.8 mm gap variation, resulting in inconsistent fit-up and inadequate weld penetration.
corrective_action: Replaced worn locator pins, requalified welding setup, and reworked affected parts using approved repair procedure.
preventive_action: Implement monthly fixture dimensional verification and maintain spare locator pin inventory with replacement criteria.

defect_description: Bearing bore diameter measured above upper specification limit, causing improper bearing fit during assembly.
containment_action: Placed affected housings on hold and performed 100% dimensional inspection of all components machined on CNC Line 3.
root_cause: Tool offset was incorrectly updated after cutter replacement, producing oversized bores by 0.12-0.18 mm.
corrective_action: Corrected CNC offset parameters, replaced affected tooling, and remachined salvageable parts.
preventive_action: Introduce mandatory first-off inspection after tool changes and electronic approval of offset modifications.

defect_description: Paint surface exhibited blistering and localized adhesion failure after curing. Defects became visible during final quality inspection.
containment_action: Stopped paint line operations, quarantined affected hoods, and initiated adhesion testing on work-in-process inventory.
root_cause: Pre-treatment wash tank concentration dropped below specified level, leaving residual oil contamination on surface.
corrective_action: Adjusted chemical concentration, cleaned process tanks, and stripped/repainted affected components.
preventive_action: Install automated chemical concentration monitoring with daily verification records and alarm notifications.
